subject: Waterway information - Bridge Construction - Fraser River
text:
Waterway information - Bridge Construction - Fraser River
Bridge construction is ongoing on the Patullo Bridge at 49 12.500N 122 53.533W.
Hours of operation from 1300 to 0900 UTC daily.
Mariners are asked to avoid areas marked with flashing amber lights and to contact work vessels on channel 74 
ninety minutes prior to transiting for restrictions and current channel closures.
Vessels on site monitoring VHF channels 16, 69, 71 and 74.
Speed restriction upstream and downstream of Project area;
- 5 knots (10 km/hr) within 100 m of the shoreline, and,
- 10 knots (19 km/hr) beyond 100 m from shore.
Minimum wake.
                                                    Cancels NW-P-1179-26
